svg.title: Ecological thresholds
svg.desc: Simplified original concept map. Branches explain connected dimensions, not a timeline or a claim that one factor guarantees an outcome. Pressure: Heat, water stress or habitat damage place pressure on an ecosystem. Threshold: Beyond a critical limit, responses can become abrupt rather than gradual. Monitoring: Local measurements can reveal warning signals that broad averages miss.
svg.text: Heat, water stress or habitat damage place pressure on an ecosystem.
